english: I fall towards, prostrate myself before
I go up to, mount, board (a boat)
(a going over [the line]), transgression, a transgression
I collect, gather together at one place
I am chief; I think, regard
I proclaim (as a herald, κῆρυξ), preach
I drink down, devour, swallow up
I lead up; middle, I put to sea, set sail
